reviews.t: Not even if they were giving it away...
reviews.x: I should have read the reviews before purchasing this. After only a couple of uses (2-3), the beads began to fall out of place. I'd be "lotioning" my back and the next thing I know, one of the beads is bouncing up knee high from my tile flooring. Yeah... not a good look.  I popped the bead(s) back in after several attempts to "make do". Finally, I gave up and tossed it. Don't waste your money (even though it's fairly inexpensive...still not worth it). In fact...I wouldn't accept

reviews.t: You get what you pay for.
reviews.x: These are very cheaply made and I don't expect them to hold together for long at all. But, while they are still in one piece, they are mostly serving their purpose. I'd look for a higher quality comparison if it is something you want to use long term.

I've owned several different ones but this is the one I keep coming back to whenever I break the current one. I use it to apply lotion on my back, and it works well. There's two main problems with this one: after so long, the rolling balls will start falling out one by one. You can still use it, but it's super annoying. Also, if you use the applicator with wet hands or hands that have lotion on them, you are likely to feel it slide out of your hands. When it hits the floor, it will bust, or ball

reviews.t: When buying the image said there was two items for this price
reviews.x: I do not dislike the item. I like it however when I was looking at the image when buying it stated two items for that price. I only received one.

I like the idea of this product, but it just didn't work very well for me. My suntan lotion almost immediately made the ball stop rolling (3 applications). Now I just have to put suntan lotion on the balls and spread it around that way. I guess it works better than the big kitchen spoon I was using, but not much better at this point.

I personally don’t like to use the wand attachment. I strongly recommend that you either use gel lotions, or add some water to your existing lotion to fit it out. Otherwise, the lotion roller may struggle a bit with even distribution of thicker lotions. It’s easy so easy to use that I now include it in my after shower care routine!

I had almost the exact thing (made in Germany though) and it just broke after about 15 years! I was very happy to find this. I didn't want to mess with pads or applicators that you have to apply the lotion to.
I bought this item to apply lotion on my back, areas that I cannot reach.  The lotion does not come out as much as I would like.

reviews.t: I don't usually do reviews, but...
reviews.x: I have horrible dry, itchy skin during the cool months.  Reaching my back has become increasingly difficult and I really needed some relief.  This does the trick!  It applies just the right amount of moisturizer with a gentle massaging motion.
This product works great for me. I’m going to order a second one for sunblock for the summer.
This is  the worst  hard  plastic.. and  really not  cheap....  Sry  I  bought it  :(
Put in lotion and very little comes out. I will find a thinner lotion and try
It uses a lot of cream but i have so many samples of cream that it"s great.  I bought few for gifts and everybody loves it

reviews.t: Just the scratch to my itch.
reviews.x: Works great and it feels good during the application. Such a simple and ingenious idea.
This product was perfect for when I don't have someone help put lotion on my back.
This product was perfect for when I don't have someone help put lotion on my back.

I am thrilled with this.  I also purchased the velvety version that you put lotion on and scrub across your back.  That works fine for some lotions but some fall off it.  Not with this!  I filled it to the brim with body cream and my back was so thankful.  My favorite way to get lotion on my back now.  Flows easily.  I had a hard time with it when my hands were covered in cream from applying to legs/arms, so I always do this first now.  Highly recommend as a gift or for yourself.

reviews.t: This is a piece of junk
reviews.x: I bought this to replace a similar model I'd had for about 15 years and finally developed a crack that dried out the lotion. That was a  little over a year ago. It worked ok for about 6 months then started coming apart - the rolling balls started popping out, it came loose from the handle, the head unscrewed itself. I finally completely gave up on it today when it wouldn't stay together at all. There are many other similar models - this one is not worth the money.

It kinda works, but not fabulously. The clear lid that I gather should let you leave lotion in it just will not stay on at all, so I finally just started sticking that end of it in a ziploc sandwich bag and zipping it up, just don't even bother with the lid anymore, but it's still going to dry out faster, and that can be a real mess to scrape out later on. Queries for a replacement lid, in case that's the problem, will get you nowhere.

reviews.t: Finally some relief for dry skin!
reviews.x: The lotion applicator works fairly well and allows this one-armed, disabled senior to reach and lotion up her back, but also her legs and feet.  Of the various applicators I've bought, this is the best. It leaves a very light layer of lotion, so it takes me several applications to relieve my dragon skin, but at least it doesn't leave behind huge gobs of lotion!

reviews.t: It's a good lotion applicator, but it clogs.
reviews.x: This is a great invention, now I don't have to ask anyone to put lotion 🧴 on my back and other hard to reach places on my body. The only thing is it will clog on you making the lotion 🧴 hard to come out, but I found a way around that issue. This lotion applicator also is great for self massages.

I had one of these before, but could not find it when a doctor prescribed  a lotion about the thickness of a moist hand cream. This new applicator seized the roller balls in three months. Then the roller balls started to fall out. Disappointed with the newer one. The first one was great.

I have been searching for a long time for this product, it works and I love it , it’s hard to find one that you put your lotion inside and have it distributed out the rollers on their work it’s got a nice clear cover and all I can say is it worked very well!

reviews.t: Not worth the money. Major defects.
reviews.x: Great at 1st then the rollers get quickly gunked up with lotion and won't move. Also the lotion constantly move to the lower side of unit, so you only get no lotion on 1 side or even bigger area. Not worth the money.

Perhaps I did not read directions? I added moisturizer to the entire inside.....the center circle and all the spaces around it - but the white roller balls have started falling out of this. Not sure how to fix this?

claims.text: Many reviewers find the applicator works well for reaching and applying lotion to their back, with several calling it easy to use.
A common complaint is that the rolling balls fall out or stop rolling after only a few uses.
Some reviewers describe the product as cheaply made and not durable for long-term use.
Several reviewers note that thicker lotions dispense poorly or struggle to come out, suggesting thinner lotions or adding water.
A few reviewers mention receiving only one item despite the listing showing two for the price.
